turns.prompt:
You are given two attached CSV files:
  - cdft_piezo_d_eg_train.csv: 200 crystalline materials, columns `formula`,
    `poscar` (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format), `d_ij` (the
    piezoelectric strain coefficient max|d_ij|, in pC/N) and `band_gap` (the
    band gap, in eV).
  - cdft_piezo_pool.csv: 100 CANDIDATE crystalline materials whose
    properties are NOT given, columns `candidate_id`, `formula` and `poscar`
    (the crystal structure, in POSCAR format).

Using the training data, select the 5 candidates with the LARGEST
piezoelectric strain coefficient max|d_ij| (in pC/N) that also satisfy a
low-leakage requirement: the band gap must be at least 5 eV. Band gaps are
NOT given for the pool -- you must infer them. A selected candidate whose
band gap is below the threshold scores zero.

Reason from the structures, then end your answer with an explicit ranked
list of candidate_ids, best first, e.g. "Final: c901, c902, c903, c904,
c905".
turns.answer_text:
The training set shows that large max\(|d_{ij}|\) coexists with \(E_g\ge5\,\mathrm{eV}\) only for a few chemically related families: hydroxides (CaH\(_2\)O\(_2\), \(d=15.1\)), phosphates (selected AlPO\(_4\) polymorphs, \(d\) up to 12.8) and carbonates (BaCO\(_3\), \(d=9.9\)). All other high-\(d\) entries have gaps well below the 5 eV cutoff.

Among the 100 candidates the only members of these families that also satisfy the gap requirement (light electropositive cations + O/N/F, no heavy p-block or d-metal cations) are the three BeH\(_2\)O\(_2\) polymorphs, K\(_2\)SrP\(_4\)O\(_{12}\) and the lowest-symmetry Na\(_4\)CO\(_4\). Their structures are polar (non-centrosymmetric lattices, anisotropic cell metrics, no inversion-related atomic pairs). Scaling the training analogues by cation polarizability and structural anisotropy therefore ranks them

BeH\(_2\)O\(_2\) (most anisotropic cell) \(>\) remaining BeH\(_2\)O\(_2\) \(>\) K\(_2\)SrP\(_4\)O\(_{12}\) \(>\) Na\(_4\)CO\(_4\).

All other pool entries either fall below the gap threshold (chalcogenides, pnictides, most halides) or belong to families whose training \(d_{ij}\) values are \(\lesssim5\,\mathrm{pC\,N^{-1}}\).

Final: c079, c080, c081, c005, c066
